test.name: Init-flavored 'start research' on an existing project must not re-init
test.description: The user says 'start research' — wording that is an explicit init-project trigger phrase — but a research.json already exists in the folder. The refuse-if-exists guard must hold against init-flavored wording (not just the 'add a question' phrasing covered by ut_init_project_003) and route to project-status. This is the second phrasing variant of the single named neighbor.

input.user_message: Start research on this project — where do things stand and what should I work on next?

negative.explanation: A research.json already exists (mid-research-flynn). init-project only creates a brand-new project from scratch; its guard clause refuses when research.json is present. Even though 'start research' is an init-project trigger phrase, the refuse-if-exists invariant must hold and route the user to project-status to review the existing project state. The skill must NOT re-run the initialization workflow or call person_read/person_search. WIDENED 2026-10-06 to accept `research` as well. The invariant this test guards is that init-project REFUSES when research.json exists, and that is what it must fail on. The message reads both ways on purpose -- 'Start research on this project' is the research router's territory and 'where do things stand' is project-status's -- so insisting on one of the two graded a coin-flip rather than the refusal. Measured: init-project declined in both the 2026-10-06 15:53 run (routed project-status, pass) and the 18:05 run (routed research, fail), with activated=False in each. A run where init-project ACTIVATES still fails, whichever destination follows, so the defect this test was built to catch is untouched. GRADED ON THE INVARIANT from 2026-10-07: a third destination appeared that no `correct_skill` list can contain -- the run invoked Claude Code's BUILT-IN `init` skill, which analysed the codebase and wrote a CLAUDE.md into the workspace. Across 16 committed runs the destination has been project-status (13x), research (1x), nothing (1x) and init (1x), and it only started moving when project-status became an agent on 2026-10-03; the invariant held in every one of them, including both failures. `test_existing_project_is_not_reinitialized` is what enforces it, and it asserts activation mechanically -- no person_read, person_search or project_create -- so grading on the invariant is not vacuous here: _compute_outcome only reaches the invariant branch once validators pass. correct_skill is kept so the reciprocity lint still reads this edge.

judge_context: Should decline to initialize (research.json already exists) and route to the research skill (which reviews the existing project's state) or the project-status agent, not re-run the init workflow
Should make no MCP tool calls — no person_read, no person_search, no place_search

Judge the routing decision and the absence of init work only. Once the run routes, the harness stops it and `text_response` is empty, so there is no decline wording to weigh here — the guard clause's literal one-line text is not gradable on this test and must not be scored as present or absent.
